AboutThe story so far

I’m Sudharsini, a Computer Science and Engineering student at Jai Shriram Engineering College, Tiruppur, with a CGPA of 8.73 and a latest GPA of 9.2. My core interest is data: designing databases, writing SQL that answers real questions, and turning raw numbers into dashboards people can actually read. Alongside that, I build AI-powered applications, write prompts that get dependable results from language models, and design interfaces in Figma that feel simple to use.

My journey started with a quiz win, my first taste of competing and winning. A value-added course in Power BI then pulled me firmly into analytics, and a Google goodie box from the Code Arena event told me that showing up and trying pays off. From there I grew from a department representative into the Vice President of the Igniters Club, and I now serve as its President, leading teammates, planning events and keeping the club’s energy high.

As a Google Student Ambassador I have conducted more than 10 events, helping fellow students get comfortable with Gemini and AI tools. I’ve also served as Infosys Project Coordinator and Geeks for Geeks Campus Mantri, and my work in coordination was recognised with a Best Coordinator award at the department’s award ceremony.

Beyond campus, I’ve completed four trainings and internships across Java, mobile app development and AI, and I’ve built projects such as Link Compressor Pro, NexDoorPro, a Medi Card platform and Thuliraa Vision. I like learning in public, shipping things that work, and helping the people around me grow with me.
